title: Comment on "Ultraviolet Completion of the Big Bang in Quadratic Gravity"
summary: We examine the round Euclidean no-boundary saddle proposed by Liu, Quintin, and Afshordi in "Ultraviolet Completion of the Big Bang in Quadratic Gravity." For a free, massless, conformal realization of their large matter sector, the omitted type-A trace anomaly contributes at leading order in the matter multiplicity. Within the one-loop renormalization-group-improved pure quadratic truncation, both the sphere effective action and the local trace equation show that a stationary point of the running $R^2$ coupling supports a round sphere only if the total Euler anomaly coefficient vanishes.…
